g.text: Why can stable full-gradient steps zig-zag while progress along the valley stays slow?

text.style: font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: Conclusion: Unequal eigenvalues mean unequal contraction. Near the stability limit the stiff mode flips while the flat mode

text.style: font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: decays slowly, producing zig-zags. Increasing batch size cannot repair this full-gradient conditioning problem.
